answer: A fixed pool starves forgery: the 40,000 pool pays audited filings only. Each identity stakes 70 credits and files one signed sonnet, a 14-line fresh-serial log. Auditors check each sonnet on a public prism; a wrong line, reused serial, or rented sonnet burns the stake. Each verified filing earns one pearl share. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes spend 3,037,000, stake 70,000, for 40,000 max. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
